arStrings.szText: A Blade's Weight
Enter the Archive of the First Son
Enter the Archive of the First Son

A Firstborn archive sits beneath the Temple, and it might hold clues about Lilith's blade. Yet we are not the first to come looking for this place. The Hands of Akarat ventured into it already. I must explore the archive and discover what I can, before it's too late.

Enter the archive
Enter the archive

Lilith has spoken to me, without using the Sightless Eye. What does it mean? How much power does she have? I am not yet certain, but for now I must continue my search for clues about her blade. It seems this archive belonged to Rathma. It could hold useful knowledge.

Speak with Lorath
Speak with Lorath

Rathma believes that Lilith's blade will only lead to ruin, and yet he did not destroy it completely. He is testing my resolve, but it seems the hardest test is yet to come. Whatever the risk, I must find this blade and banish Mephisto to the Void.
Defeat Rathma's Golem
Defeat Rathma's Golem

Rathma left behind a golem, infused with his own essence. This hidden chamber is devoted to Lilith's blade. He seems wary of anyone using it, yet he left these clues behind for a reason. Perhaps he believes, despite the risks, this weapon is necessary to protect Sanctuary. He aims to test my strength and resolve. I will pass that test.
